findings.summary: Recovery invokes Windows PowerShell 5.1, which lacks the bridge-required ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList.
findings.evidence: Independent no-secret child capability check returned version 5.1.26100.9444 and argumentListAvailable=false. Bridge invocation cannot reach valid inspection.
findings.required_repair: Use exact available modern shell and test child capability without credentials.

validation.boundary: Frozen real admission/main with synthetic review artifacts, isolated files and actual fsync; all external processes/provider observations mocked. Only shell capability probe used a real no-secret child.

limits: No credential, provider, hosted database, deployment or source release action.
Acknowledgement does not prove availability or readiness.
